# ScooterWale — full electric scooter dataset for India

Source: https://www.escooterwale.in
Last updated: 2026-10-18
Models: 44 | Brands: 10

Prices are ex-showroom in Indian rupees unless stated. "Claimed range (IDC)" is the
manufacturer figure under the Indian Driving Cycle. "Real-world range" is ScooterWale's
own estimate for Normal/City mode with a single rider in mixed Indian city traffic, and
is consistently lower than the IDC claim. ScootScore is ScooterWale's independent 0-10
rating averaged across five published components.

## Real range test results (measured, March 2026)

Test conditions: identical 10 km Mumbai urban loop, single 72 kg rider, Normal/City mode,
mixed morning traffic, ambient 28-32°C, 100% to 0% state of charge.

| Rank | Model | Battery | IDC claim | Measured real range | Efficiency |
|------|-------|---------|-----------|---------------------|------------|
| 1 | TVS iQube ST | 5.3 kWh | 212 km | 165 km | 77.8% |
| 2 | Ola Electric S1 Pro+ | 5.2 kWh | 320 km | 155 km | 48.4% |
| 3 | Pure EV ETrance+ | 4.5 kWh | 171 km | 148 km | 86.5% |
| 4 | Ola Electric S1 Pro | 4 kWh | 176 km | 140 km | 79.5% |
| 5 | Ather Energy 450X | 3.7 kWh | 161 km | 125 km | 77.6% |
| 6 | Hero Vida V2 Pro | 3.94 kWh | 143 km | 118 km | 82.5% |
| 7 | Bajaj Chetak 3503 | 3.5 kWh | 153 km | 116 km | 75.8% |
| 8 | Ampere Nexus ST | 3 kWh | 136 km | 112 km | 82.4% |

Average IDC-to-real efficiency: 77.4%. Rule of thumb: multiply an IDC claim by 0.77 for a
Normal-mode city estimate, 0.9 for Eco mode, 0.65 for aggressive riding.

## Brands

### Ola Electric
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/ola-electric
- Models: 6
- Founded: 2017
- Headquarters: Bengaluru
- Official site: https://www.olaelectric.com
- About: India's #1 EV scooter brand by sales. MoveOS 5 software, 36L boot, 90–117 km/h range across S1 series. Gen 3 launched 2026.

### Ather Energy
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/ather-energy
- Models: 5
- Founded: 2013
- Headquarters: Bengaluru
- Official site: https://www.atherenergy.com
- About: India's premium EV brand. Best ride quality, Ather Grid fast-charging, 3.3 hr charge on 450X. Rizta is best-selling family scooter.

### TVS Motor
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/tvs-motor
- Models: 4
- Founded: 1978
- Headquarters: Chennai
- Official site: https://www.tvsmotor.com
- About: India's most reliable EV service network — 4500+ centres nationwide. iQube ST 5.3 kWh delivers 212 km claimed range.

### Bajaj Chetak
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/bajaj-chetak
- Models: 5
- Founded: 1945
- Headquarters: Pune
- Official site: https://www.chetak.com
- About: India's iconic scooter nameplate, revived electric. All-metal body, 35L boot, 4000+ dealers. C2501 to 3503 — 5 variants.

### Hero Vida
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/hero-vida
- Models: 3
- Founded: 2022
- Headquarters: New Delhi
- Official site: https://www.vidaworld.com
- About: Hero MotoCorp's EV arm. 6000+ Hero service points. VX2 has removable battery (BaaS model). Best hero service coverage in India.

### Ampere
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/ampere
- Models: 5
- Founded: 2008
- Headquarters: Coimbatore
- Official site: https://www.greavesamperev.com
- About: India's oldest EV brand (2008). 5000+ dealers in 500+ cities. LFP batteries in Nexus range. Tier-2/3 India's most accessible EV.

### Okinawa
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/okinawa
- Models: 5
- Founded: 2015
- Headquarters: Gurugram
- Official site: https://www.okinawa.co.in
- About: 10 years EV experience. 700+ dealers. Budget to mid-range. Okhi-90 is only Okinawa with 90 km/h. Entry R30 starts at ₹61,998.

### Pure EV
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/pure-ev
- Models: 3
- Founded: 2019
- Headquarters: Hyderabad
- Official site: https://pureev.in
- About: IIT Hyderabad incubated. ETrance+ has 3G LTE, best real range in budget segment. Swappable batteries available.

### Bounce Infinity
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/bounce-infinity
- Models: 2
- Founded: 2021
- Headquarters: Bengaluru
- Official site: https://www.bounceev.com
- About: Battery-swap pioneer. E1 is India's lowest-priced EV with swap support. BaaS model eliminates battery cost upfront.

### BGauss
- URL: https://www.escooterwale.in/brands/bgauss
- Models: 3
- Founded: 2020
- Headquarters: Mumbai
- Official site: https://www.bgauss.com
- About: RR Kabel backed Mumbai EV brand. Premium build quality above price. D15i and RUV 350i are flagship models.

- Best for: Tech-forward buyers in metro cities; Daily commutes needing 80–90 km real range
- Avoid if: Tier-2 city buyers without Ola service; Buyers who prefer physical controls
